key.name: guard-enabled
key.description: Master switch. When false, no retention or expiry rules are enforced.

key.name: screenshot-notify-enabled
key.description: When false, screenshot notifications are discarded as soon as they are received.

key.name: screenshot-thumbnail-mode
key.description: "full" keeps the full-resolution image in the notification. "compact" replaces it with a downscaled preview thumbnail (~128 px), reducing memory usage while preserving a visual preview. "text-only" replaces it with a small themed icon, releasing the full-size texture while keeping the notification text and actions.

key.name: screenshot-max-count
key.description: Oldest screenshot notifications are destroyed beyond this count. Zero means unlimited, subject to emergency-hard-cap.

key.name: screenshot-expire-seconds
key.description: Seconds before a screenshot notification is destroyed. Zero disables expiry. This closes the GNOME Do-Not-Disturb transient-notification leak.

key.name: screenshot-memory-budget-mb
key.description: Prunes oldest screenshot notifications when the estimated texture memory exceeds this many MiB. Zero disables the budget.

key.name: emergency-hard-cap
key.summary: Emergency hard cap on tracked notifications
key.description: Last-resort bound so the guard cannot be disarmed into causing the very memory growth it prevents. Zero disables the cap.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Display the Notman status icon and quick menu in the top bar.

key.name: clear-on-panel-open
key.summary: Clear screenshot notifications when the notification list opens
